scripts.clone-upstream:no-fetch: rimraf temp && mkdir temp && cd temp && mkdir _ss14-repo && cd _ss14-repo && git init && git remote add origin https://github.com/space-wizards/space-station-14.git && git sparse-checkout init && git sparse-checkout set Resources/
scripts.clone-upstream:stable: bun run clone-upstream:no-fetch && cd temp && cd _ss14-repo && git fetch --depth=1 origin stable && git checkout stable
scripts.clone-upstream:master: bun run clone-upstream:no-fetch && cd temp && cd _ss14-repo && git fetch --depth=1 origin master && git checkout master
scripts.clone-sync: mkdir temp && cd temp && rimraf temp _sync && mkdir _sync && cd _sync && git init && git remote add origin https://github.com/murolem/ss14-wiki-automations.git && git fetch --depth=1 origin sync && git checkout sync
scripts.start: bun run type-check && bun run test && bun run clone-upstream:master && bun run start:cli
